main_text.p: [illegible, ~20 letters] Greek entries with Latin glosses: "monstro", "rogo", "doceo", "fugio", "appareo", "subsido" (Greek verbs with F., P., Ind., Perfect. and pass. forms), each entry as printed.
main_text.head: E.
main_text.p: Greek entries: "edo", P. act. ἥκα, pro ἔδηκα: attice; P. med. ἐδηδοκα; F. 2. med. ἔδομαι, pro ἔδεσμαι.
"volo", F. ἐθελήσω. Ind. 1. ἠθέλησα, ab ἐθέλω.

"video", F. ἴσομαι, & ἴσομαι: vel ἐδήσω, ab ἐιδέω. P. act. ἴδηκα, & persyncopen εἶδα. Plusquamp. ἰδήκειν, & εἴδειν: attice ἤδειν. Ind. 2. εἶδον, & ἴδον: quae posterior forma in caeteris modis retinetur; ἰδῶ, ἴδομι, ἴδω, ἰδὲν. P. pass. ἐσμαι, ἐσαι.
Greek characters in this page are largely rendered approximately; see notes.

page.notes: Page heavily stained and faded; Greek and Greek-Latin mixed entries transcribed approximately, many accents uncertain. Marked [illegible] where the first entry line could not be read. The head "E." is a section letter, not a heading of a division.
